summary:
## Getting Started with Odoo CRM
Odoo CRM is a powerful tool for managing customer relationships from lead generation to closing deals. You can begin with a free account on **odoo.com**.

- The main interface includes modules for **CRM**, **Discuss** (communication), **Calendar**, and **Apps**.
- The CRM dashboard is divided into **Sales**, **Reporting**, and **Configuration** sections for easy navigation.

## Core CRM Functions

### Sales Pipeline
The primary view is a **Kanban board** that visually tracks opportunities through different stages:
- **New**
- **Qualified**
- **Proposition**
- **Won**

You can drag-and-drop deals between stages as they progress. You can also customize the pipeline by adding new stages, such as a "Failed Deals" column.

### Lead Generation
Odoo includes a built-in tool to **generate new leads**. You can filter potential contacts by:
- **Industry**
- **Company Size**
- **Role** (e.g., Consulting)

### Customizing Views
You can change how you view your pipeline data. Popular views include:
- **Kanban**: The default visual board.
- **List**: A simple, sortable list format.
- **Calendar**: To view time-sensitive activities.
- **Graph & Pivot**: For data analysis.

## Reporting & Analytics
Odoo provides robust reporting tools to analyze your sales performance.

- **Leads Report**: Track the volume of leads generated over time.
- **Pipeline Report**: A visual analysis of deal distribution across stages.
- **Key Metrics**: Analyze your data using measures like **Expected Revenue** and **Days to Convert**.
- **Chart Types**: View data as bar charts, line graphs, or pie charts.

## Advanced Configuration & Organization
Proper configuration helps streamline your workflow and gather better insights.

- **Tags**: Use tags to categorize and filter leads, opportunities, and contacts.
  > [!TIP]
  > Assign tags based on service type (e.g., "employee management course") or lead source to quickly find specific groups of contacts.

- **Lost Reasons**: Define and assign reasons when a deal is lost.
  > [!IMPORTANT]
  > Tracking why deals fail is crucial for identifying weaknesses in your sales process and making improvements.

## Collaboration & Integration

- **Team Communication**: The built-in **Discuss** module provides an inbox for team members to communicate, collaborate on deals, and manage deadlines.
- **Contact Management**: Create detailed contact profiles for individuals and companies. You can add private **internal notes** visible only to your team.
- **App Integration**: Extend CRM functionality by installing other Odoo apps like **Invoicing**, **Sales**, and **Inventory** directly into your environment.
